title: Translate
description: Translates a given text into a different language.

title: Romanize/Transliterate
description: Transliterates the given Cyrillic text into english.

title: Translated Text
description: Returns the translated text of a string as a language.

title: Translate Specific
description:
Different from the Translate effect in that it specifies the current language of the string
This can help to reduce misunderstandings caused by the auto-detect language.
syntax_pattern:
translate %strings% to %language% from %language%
translate %strings% from %language% to %language%
